desc: Ideation: trie formulation (outside path count>=k, on-path count>=k+1) is correct.
Implement trie build: insert all words, track count and depth per node; handle n == k early return zeros.
Compute mx[node] = max depth in subtree with count >= k using reverse node order (children before parent).
Compute best1/best2/bestc top-two child mx per node for O(1) sibling-subtree lookup.
Per word: traverse path, combine sibling subtrees (best_out) and path nodes with count>=k+1 (best_on), include terminal children; answer = max(best_out, best_on).
Verified on Example 1 (output [3,4,4,3,4]) and edge cases: k=1, duplicates, words that are prefixes of others, n==k, all-distinct.
